findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "basket_link" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Make a link to our website's basket with these appliances already in it: new items by model number, and/or specific graded units by graded_id (at their graded p…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, create_basket · Private data: send_enquiry, create_basket · Public sink: send_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, create_basket · Private data: send_enquiry, create_basket · Public sink: send_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
